observations.code_quote: - The packer builds a request only for a free worker slot, from ready keys up to a target size. Keys stay unclaimed until then, so a key's run keeps growing while every slot is busy, up to the target. A key's backlog past the target leaves in consecutive requests, one in flight at a time. A request never mixes assignment epochs or fresh and replayed messages.
